title: Labour Accident benefit Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board

scheme.name: Labour Accident benefit Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
scheme.summary: Financial assistance is provided to workers who become disabled during their duty period due to an accident or other reason at the working premises of the establishment.
eligibility: Workers disabled during their duty period due to an accident or any other reason at the working premises.
Workers whose organization or unit has regularly paid their Labour Welfare Fund for the last one year.
scheme.benefits: Financial assistance of Rs. 25,000 for disability between 40% and 70%, and Rs. 50,000 for disability exceeding 70%.
documents: Copy of identity card issued by the contractor to the worker
Proof of payment of said amount by the organization
Bank account details or Bank Passbook
scheme.how_to_apply: Apply online by visiting the Sanman Portal, registering under Citizen Login using Aadhaar and Labour Welfare Fund Account details, logging in, selecting the scheme, and submitting the application form.
